title: FAIRNESS ANALYSIS OF CLIP-BASED FOUNDATION MODELS FOR X-RAY IMAGE CLASSIFICATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance disparities between male and female patients using fairness metrics like Gap of F1 Score, Equalized Odds, and Gap of Expected Calibration Error on a curated, balanced chest X-ray dataset.

Evaluating classification performance disparities between young (< 60 years) and old (>= 60 years) patients using fairness metrics like Gap of F1 Score, Equalized Odds, and Gap of Expected Calibration Error on a curated, balanced chest X-ray dataset.
Measuring the variance of class-wise F1 scores across six different disease categories to assess whether the model performs equitably across different health conditions.
